item.title: U.S. economy's K-shaped gap narrows
item.description: The gap between high-income and other consumers is closing, as spending patterns become more balanced.

item.title: Tech giants propose new incident reporting framework for AI agents
item.description: A coalition of over 120 organizations, including Nvidia, Cisco, and CrowdStrike, has proposed a new framework for reporting incidents involving AI agents.

item.title: Security leaders face decision fatigue over AI cyber threats
item.description: Security leaders at major firms, despite increased budgets for AI-driven cyber defense, are experiencing decision paralysis due to the overwhelming number of choices.

item.title: Why 'chipflation' is expected to persist
item.description: Memory chip prices are rising sharply due to AI demand, and analysts predict the trend will continue. Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED.
